title: perf: simply work done in parse_tag a bit

verdicts.label: intended
verdicts.rationale: The docstring for parse_tag states ".. versionadded:: 26.3 Raises :class:`InvalidTag` on empty tag components." and the code change replaces the ValueError with raising InvalidTag for empty components.
evidence:
.. versionadded:: 26.3
   Raises :class:`InvalidTag` on empty tag components.
raise InvalidTag(f"Tag {tag!r} has an empty component: {component!r}")
class InvalidTag(ValueError):
Raises :class:`InvalidTag` on empty tag components.
verdicts.facts: Outcome differs. Input ["-"]: base raises builtins.ValueError, head raises packaging.tags.InvalidTag. (packaging.tags.InvalidTag is a subclass of builtins.ValueError.)
